🎯 DORI Standard Distance Estimator
According to EN 62676-4, DORI levels are based on Pixels Per Meter (PPM):

• Detection (25 PPM): ~40–60m (4mm lens)
• Observation (62 PPM): ~18–25m
• Recognition (125 PPM): ~9–12m
• Identification (250 PPM): ~4–6m (Court-admissible face recognition)
